articles.title: Tamil Nadu: One-Year-Old Falls from Moving Bus After Sudden Brake, Escapes with Minor Injuries
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A one-year-old child sustained minor injuries after falling from a moving private bus near Meenakshipuram village in Tamil Nadu's Virudhunagar district. The incident occurred on July 31, when the driver applied a sudden brake, causing panic among passengers.

body.html:
A one-year-old child sustained minor injuries after falling from a moving private bus near Meenakshipuram village in Tamil Nadu's Virudhunagar district. The incident occurred on July 31, when the driver applied a sudden brake, causing panic among passengers.

The bus was en route from Madurai to Srivilliputhur. The infant, travelling with his mother, elder brother, and uncle Madhan Kumar, fell from his mother’s arms during the jolt and tumbled out of the vehicle near the entrance.

CCTV footage from inside the bus confirmed the abrupt stop led to the fall. A passerby, an elderly man nearby, quickly rushed to rescue the child. Fortunately, both the baby and his elder sibling sustained only minor injuries and bruises. Madhan Kumar suffered facial injuries in the impact.

articles.title: Shameful in Bareilly: Nepali Woman Brutally Beaten Over False Theft Rumour — 4 Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of mob violence has surfaced from Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, where a 22-year-old Nepali woman was brutally beaten by a group of youths after being falsely accused of theft. The disturbing video of the incident has gone viral, prompting widespread outrage.

body.html:
A shocking case of mob violence has surfaced from Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, where a 22-year-old Nepali woman was brutally beaten by a group of youths after being falsely accused of theft. The disturbing video of the incident has gone viral, prompting widespread outrage.

The woman, who works in a private firm in Noida, had come to Bareilly’s Fort area after being called by two men — Resham Singh and Vinay Gangwar — on the pretext of a job opportunity. While she was speaking on the phone on a rooftop in Mohalla Baradari, a rumour spread that a thief was seen escaping via rooftops. Without any verification, locals dragged her down, tied her braid, and beat her mercilessly — all while she screamed, "I am not a thief."

Police acted after the video went viral and have arrested four accused: Gaurav Shivam (18), Shivam Saxena (22), Aman Saxena (24), and Anil Saini (19). The rest are absconding. The victim was taken to a hospital for treatment and the investigation is ongoing.

SP City Manush Pareek confirmed the arrests and said efforts are underway to nab all those involved.

articles.title: “Less Salt at Home, Dal Makhani Outside!” Ghaziabad Wife Catches Husband Cheating
articles.author: The Times Patriot

body.html:
Ghaziabad: A dramatic scene unfolded at a restaurant when a woman caught her husband red-handed enjoying dal makhani with his girlfriend. Furious, she shouted, “At home he complains about salt, and here he’s relishing dal makhani!”

The husband fled the spot, but the wife and her relatives caught the girlfriend on the road and beat her up publicly, attracting a large crowd. The incident took place in Mata Mohalla, while the girlfriend is reportedly from Bhojpur.

Police arrived on receiving information, brought both parties to the station, and initiated questioning.

articles.title: Gym Turns Tragic: 37-Year-Old Man Collapses & Dies Post Workout in Pune
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Pune: A 37-year-old man, Milind Kulkarni, died after collapsing inside Nitrro Gym in Pimpri-Chinchwad on Thursday morning. The entire incident was caught on CCTV.

body.html:
Pune: A 37-year-old man, Milind Kulkarni, died after collapsing inside Nitrro Gym in Pimpri-Chinchwad on Thursday morning. The entire incident was caught on CCTV.

According to footage and eyewitnesses, Kulkarni had just finished his workout and was sipping water when he suddenly collapsed. He was immediately rushed to Yashwantrao Chavan Memorial Hospital (YCMH), where doctors declared him dead on arrival.

Initial reports suggest a heart attack as the probable cause. Kulkarni had been a regular at the gym for six months. His wife is reportedly a doctor.

articles.title: “Yamraj in Uniform?” Viral Video Shows Man Brutally Beaten with Belt Inside Police Station
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking video has surfaced showing a man being mercilessly beaten with a leather belt inside a police station. The victim can be seen screaming in pain, trying to escape, while the uniformed man thrashes him relentlessly.

body.html:
A shocking video has surfaced showing a man being mercilessly beaten with a leather belt inside a police station. The victim can be seen screaming in pain, trying to escape, while the uniformed man thrashes him relentlessly. A stick is also seen nearby, indicating further threat of violence.

The video is said to be from Agra, Uttar Pradesh, and has gone viral across social media, raising serious concerns over police brutality.

However, Agra Police issued a statement distancing itself, saying:

“This video does not appear to be from Uttar Pradesh Police. The belt used is not standard UP Police gear, and no UP Police monogram is visible above the nameplate.”

Despite this, the police confirmed that the video has been taken into cognizance and an investigation is underway. They assured that if the video is found to be from Agra, strict action will be taken against the accused personnel.

articles.title: UP: Boy Dies of Electrocution in Ballia, Police Lathi Charge on Protesting Women Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: #InShort | Rakesh Shah died of electric shock while doing home repairs. Locals protesting the inaction were met with a brutal lathi charge. Shocking visuals show women being chased, beaten & dragged from shops.

body.html:
#InShort | Rakesh Shah died of electric shock while doing home repairs. Locals protesting the inaction were met with a brutal lathi charge. Shocking visuals show women being chased, beaten & dragged from shops.

* * *

A tragic incident unfolded in Ballia district's Bansdih, where a boy named Rakesh Shah, son of Satendra Turaha, died of electric shock while doing domestic electrical work. Despite being rushed to the hospital, doctors declared him dead during treatment.

Local residents, angered by the lack of action, blocked the road in protest. Tension escalated when police resorted to a lathi charge to disperse the crowd. Disturbing visuals and eyewitness accounts reveal that women were chased, beaten, and even dragged out from nearby shops where they had taken shelter.

The Ballia Police confirmed the electrocution incident on 29.07.25, but the violent crackdown on grieving and protesting citizens, especially women, has drawn sharp criticism.

📍 Protesters demand accountability and compensation.
📍 Human rights activists have condemned the use of force on civilians.

articles.title: Tragedy in Ladakh: 2 Brave Punjab Soldiers Martyred in Landslide While on Duty
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: #InShort | Lt Col Bhanu Pratap Singh (Pathankot) and Naik Daljit Singh (Gurdaspur) were martyred after a massive rockfall crushed their convoy on the Durbuk–Chongtash route. Naik Daljit had just planned his dream home. He was the sole breadwinner for his family.

body.html:
#InShort | Lt Col Bhanu Pratap Singh (Pathankot) and Naik Daljit Singh (Gurdaspur) were martyred after a massive rockfall crushed their convoy on the Durbuk–Chongtash route. Naik Daljit had just planned his dream home. He was the sole breadwinner for his family. Three officers injured in the incident are stable and under treatment in Leh.

* * *

In a heartbreaking incident, Lt Col Bhanu Pratap Singh (Pathankot) and Naik Daljit Singh (Gurdaspur) were martyred in Ladakh after a massive rockfall struck their convoy on the Durbuk–Chongtash route. Their vehicle was crushed by falling debris during routine duty on Wednesday morning.

Naik Daljit, who served in the Army for 9 years, had just planned the construction of his dream home. In a tragic coincidence, his family finalized a mason the day they received news of his martyrdom.

Three others – Major Mayank Shubham, Major Amit Dixit, and Captain Gaurav – were injured and are under treatment in Leh; all are reported stable.

Daljit was the sole breadwinner for his family in Shamsherpur, including aged parents and siblings. Lt Col Bhanu Pratap was recently promoted – a proud milestone now turned into grief.

Their mortal remains are being flown to Pathankot and will be laid to rest with full military honours.

articles.title: Noida Shocker: Minor Girl Kidnapped Outside School in Broad Daylight, Rescued Within Hours
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Noida, UP – A sensational case of child abduction has rocked Sector-53 Bijauri, where a minor girl was kidnapped in broad daylight from outside a private school.

body.html:
Noida, UP – A sensational case of child abduction has rocked Sector-53 Bijauri, where a minor girl was kidnapped in broad daylight from outside a private school. The entire act was caught on CCTV, showing the accused forcing the girl into a car and fleeing the spot — a video that has since gone viral and triggered public outrage.

As per Gautam Buddha Nagar Police, the incident occurred on July 30, and a Dial-112 call alerted Sector-24 police about the abduction. A special team was immediately formed, and using CCTV footage and electronic surveillance, the police nabbed the accused Monu Yadav, son of Mande Yadav, near Parthala roundabout.

The Toyota Glanza used in the kidnapping was also recovered. The girl was rescued safely without any physical harm and reunited with her family.

While the accused has been sent to jail, police are continuing further investigation.

Meanwhile, the incident has raised serious concerns about school security in Noida. Locals are demanding increased police patrolling near educational institutions to prevent such incidents.

articles.title: Perungudi Station Chain Snatcher Caught! Accused Has Criminal Record in Mobile Theft Case
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Chennai – A viral video showing a young man snatching jewellery from a lone woman at Perungudi railway station has sparked outrage. In a swift action, the police arrested the accused, identified as Soundar alias Babaji (28) from Villupuram district.

body.html:
Chennai – A viral video showing a young man snatching jewellery from a lone woman at Perungudi railway station has sparked outrage. In a swift action, the police arrested the accused, identified as Soundar alias Babaji (28) from Villupuram district.

During interrogation, Soundar confessed to targeting the woman after briefly speaking to her and gesturing with his hand. He has a previous case registered at Maraimalainagar police station for mobile phone snatching.

Authorities are continuing further investigation into his criminal background.
